_comment: Judge ensemble panel (references/judge-ensemble.md). Each judge reviews ONE dimension, independently. `critical` judges are gates, not votes: one fail drops the item (grounding) or the claim (claims). `weight` only shapes judge_score. `kg_mode_only` judges run only when a kg_plan.json exists (TTL relations/keys). `script` judges are deterministic (scripts/judge_prepare.py) and need no model. `suggested_model` is advice for framework mode; in host-model mode you are every judge.

grounding_script.dimension: surface form exists in the source text; offsets anchor it

grounding.dimension: the items the script could not verify are textually real

mapping.dimension: tool mapping means the same thing; honest skos tier

claims.dimension: relations, hierarchy links and causal claims — from the extractor or kg_plan — are stated by THIS paper
